title: Signal: Pipfile dependency declared with a wildcard
scope: A Pipfile file that declares a Pipfile dependency whose specifier is `*`.
limitations: It matches a Pipfile dependency whose specifier is `*` in the parsed Pipfile; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A Pipfile that mentions a Pipfile dependency whose specifier is `*` in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
